clue.text: More than one fool springs back

indicators.note: back tells us to read the word for springs from right to left

parts.note: spas are mineral springs

explanation.surface: A mocking line about several fools leaping backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Saps are gullible people, so the plural is a group of fools.

clue.text: Everything about Italian restaurant suggests a certain class?

indicators.note: about tells us the total goes around the restaurant

parts.note: the sum is the whole amount
trat is short for trattoria, an Italian restaurant

explanation.surface: Eating everywhere at Italian places hints at one's social standing.
explanation.definitionFit: A stratum is a level or class within society.

clue.text: Unwilling to change, as Jones's farm became?

definitions.meaning: in Orwell's Animal Farm, Mr Jones's farm ends up run by the pigs

explanation.surface: An obstinate farmer whose land was taken over.
explanation.walkthrough: Mr Jones owns Manor Farm in George Orwell's Animal Farm; the pigs end up as its heads.
explanation.definitionFit: Pig-headed means stubborn, unwilling to change one's mind.

clue.text: Evidence of bad weather? Most running with first drop of rain, caught by thundering

indicators.note: running suggests the letters are on the move, so they get rearranged
the first drop of rain is its opening letter

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
thundering means very loud

explanation.surface: A weather forecast talking of rain falling amid thunder.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as an example: a dark cloud is one sign of bad weather, not its name.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark rain-bearing cloud is a sign that bad weather is coming.

clue.text: Time to drink up, seizing a source of drink

indicators.note: seizing means the reversed drink grabs the article inside it
in a down clue, up reads the word from bottom to top

parts.note: to tope is to drink heavily

explanation.surface: An invitation to finish your drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns TOPE to EPOT, and 'seizing' puts A inside it to give EAPOT.
explanation.definitionFit: A teapot is the vessel from which tea is poured.

clue.text: Move to new state, being let loose after return to original state

indicators.note: after puts the shuffled word behind the restoring term

parts.note: to reset is to restore to an earlier state

indicators.note: loose suggests the letters are freed and rearranged

explanation.surface: A migrant being allowed to go back home.
explanation.definitionFit: To resettle is to move and establish oneself somewhere new.

clue.text: Prayer — Rome's excited about it it's something rather special

parts.note: a collect is a short prayer in church services

indicators.note: about puts the shuffled city around the pronoun
excited means stirred up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the city name with its s, as letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A prayer stirring up Rome, which is considered remarkable.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'it' in the printed 'it it's' is a link; a collect is the short set prayer of the Anglican service.
explanation.definitionFit: A prized rarity is sought by collectors, hence special.

clue.text: Part of South Island's name written inside rings

indicators.note: written inside puts the label within the two circles

parts.note: O is ring-shaped, so two rings are OO
a tag is a name or label

explanation.surface: A New Zealand place name inscribed inside rings.
explanation.definitionFit: Otago is a region in the south of New Zealand's South Island.

clue.text: German city doctor needs to be relocated

indicators.note: relocated means moved around, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A physician has to move to a German city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be relocated' rearranges NEEDS into ESDEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Dresden is the capital of the German state of Saxony.

clue.text: Unpleasant surprise in the Scorpio horoscope?

definitions.meaning: a nasty twist at the end
Scorpio is the scorpion, which has its weapon at its rear

explanation.walkthrough: The scorpion carries its sting at the end of its tail.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a nasty surprise coming at the end of something.

clue.text: Display of boats a target at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused or disordered, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something aimed at a target out on the water.
explanation.definitionFit: A regatta is a sporting event where many boats race and are shown off.

clue.text: Brute's grabbed new driver — get back

indicators.note: grabbed means the brute holds the learner inside itself

parts.note: a savage is a brutal person
L is the learner plate on a new driver's car

explanation.surface: A thug seizes a learner motorist and demands something back.
explanation.definitionFit: To salvage something is to recover or rescue it from loss.

clue.text: When one gives up, having lost track?

definitions.text: When one gives up, having lost track?

parts.words: When one gives up, having lost track?
parts.note: a road running out leaves no track to follow, and the phrase also means the point where someone abandons an effort

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names the point at which nothing further can be done, so one quits.

clue.text: City that's wild and free

parts.note: wild can mean mad
to rid is to free

explanation.surface: A city described as untamed and liberated.
explanation.definitionFit: Madrid is the capital city of Spain.

clue.text: State of panic: parts of scenery needing fix

parts.note: flats are painted panels of theatre scenery
to pin is to fix in place

explanation.surface: A stagehand frantic about fastening bits of the set.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a flat spin is an informal idiom for being frantically agitated.

clue.text: Private takes in corporal, sergeant, etc — right joker

indicators.note: takes in puts the military grades inside the abbreviation

parts.note: PTE is the army abbreviation for private
corporal and sergeant are military ranks

explanation.surface: A private soldier messing with officers turns out to be a joker.
explanation.definitionFit: A prankster plays practical jokes on people.

clue.text: Emperor, and his refusal to engage a staff

indicators.note: engage means the refusal holds the other pieces within it

parts.note: the emperor was French, so his no is non
a pole is a staff

explanation.surface: An emperor refusing to take up a stick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'his' points to the emperor's French, giving NON rather than NO.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon Bonaparte was Emperor of the French.

clue.text: Stones appearing in live attraction? That makes a poor lie

parts.note: to be is to live or exist

indicators.note: appearing in puts the stones abbreviation within the word for attraction

parts.note: a draw is something that attracts crowds
ST is the abbreviation for stone, the weight

explanation.surface: Rocks turning up in a lively showpiece, which proves uncomfortable to lie on.
explanation.walkthrough: The plant was once used to stuff mattresses, but its straw makes a poor bed, hence a poor 'lie'.
explanation.definitionFit: Bedstraw is a plant whose dried stems were used as bedding, so it is something lain on.

clue.text: City timekeeper almost fixed

indicators.note: almost takes the final letter off the timekeeper

parts.note: a bell marks the time, as in a church or school
fast means firmly fixed

explanation.surface: A city clock that has nearly been repaired.
explanation.definitionFit: Belfast is the capital city of Northern Ireland.

clue.text: Mistakes made by scoundrel in time

indicators.note: in places the scoundrel within the period of time

parts.note: an era is a period of time
a rat is a scoundrel

explanation.surface: Blunders committed by a rogue during some period.
explanation.definitionFit: Errata is the plural of erratum, a listed printing error.

clue.text: An American award given to foremost of movies? Quite the opposite

parts.note: a Tony is an American theatre award

indicators.note: foremost means the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Giving a theatre prize to a film would be odd.
explanation.definitionFit: An antonym is a word of opposite meaning.

clue.text: His abandoned lover's achieved nothing

parts.note: read achieved nothing as did plus O, giving the name of the Carthaginian queen left behind by the Trojan hero

explanation.walkthrough: DID (achieved) plus O (nothing) gives DIDO, the queen of Carthage whom the Trojan hero deserted in Virgil's Aeneid.
explanation.definitionFit: Aeneas abandoned Dido in the Aeneid, so he is the man she loved.

clue.text: Dismissal justified by preventing delivery getting through?

definitions.text: Dismissal justified by preventing delivery getting through?

parts.words: Dismissal justified by preventing delivery getting through?
parts.note: a batsman is given out in cricket when his leg, not his bat, stops a ball that would have hit the stumps

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, LBW is a way a batsman is out: the ball would have hit the wicket but struck the leg first.
explanation.definitionFit: This cricket dismissal is given when a leg blocks a delivery that would have hit the stumps.

clue.text: Collector of stories offering little pleasure in audio format

indicators.note: in audio format means the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: something grim is joyless

explanation.surface: A storyteller whose recordings give no joy.
explanation.definitionFit: The Brothers Grimm gathered and published German folk tales.

clue.text: It's found in stone and rock

indicators.note: found in places the pronoun within the gemstone

parts.note: agate is a semi-precious stone
it is the word taken as written

explanation.surface: Something discovered inside stone and rock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rock' looks like another stone, but it is the verb meaning to shake.
explanation.definitionFit: To rock something is to shake or disturb it, a synonym of stir up.

clue.text: Turn out with cricket side and football team

parts.note: to evert is to turn inside out
the on side is the leg side of a cricket field

explanation.surface: A sports report mixing cricket and football.
explanation.walkthrough: The ON side, also called leg side, is the half of a cricket field behind the batsman's legs.
explanation.definitionFit: Everton is a Liverpool football club in England.

clue.text: No delay with writing in this paper

indicators.note: in places the writing within the newspaper's name

parts.note: the puzzle appears in The Times newspaper
lines are written text, as in lines of verse

explanation.surface: A promise that a piece will appear in this newspaper without delay.
explanation.definitionFit: Punctuality is the absence of delay, the quality of being prompt.

clue.text: Closing stages of club tour having one million on edge

indicators.note: closing stages points to the final letter of each word

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A golfer on the edge of winning a million at the end of a tour.
explanation.definitionFit: The brim is the rim or upper edge of a vessel.
